His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.

translations.web: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
translations.bsb: His snorting flashes with light, and his eyes are like the rays of dawn.
translations.kjv: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
translations.asv: His sneezings flash forth light, And his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
